The institutional investor held 28,509 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $4.83 million, up from 8,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Neumann Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $926.90 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.23% or $0.43 $188.58.
